response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> '' AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM group_averages), kept_groups AS (SELECT g.SEX, g.avg_ratio, f.mean_ratio AS first_mean FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE g.avg_ratio > f.mean_ratio), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM kept_groups) SELECT AVG(k.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(k.avg_ratio - k.first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k.avg_ratio - s.mean_ratio) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM kept_groups AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.mean_ratio;
